## Setup
```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library("GimmeMyOmics")
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("rlist")
library("Seurat")
library("cowplot")
library("kableExtra")
library("clusterProfiler")

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)
path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "enrichment")

source(file.path(path, "conf.R"))

fc_threshold  <- log2(1.5)
p_threshold <- .05

if (species == "human") {
  org_lib <- "org.Hs.eg.db"
} else {
    org_lib <- "org.Mm.eg.db"
}
library(org_lib, character.only = TRUE)
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename

method <- "ora"

if (method == "ora") {
  label_x <- "generatio"
} else {
  label_x <- "NES"
}
```

## Load data
```{r}
load(file.path(path, "clustering_markers.rda"))
load(file.path(path, "integrated_bcells5.rda"))
```

## Analysis
```{r}
if (method == "ora") {
  l_deg_proc <- list.map(
    l_deg,
    f(x) ~ {
        filter(x, Expression != "ns") %>%
        mutate(Expression = if_else(log2FoldChange > 0, "up", "down")) %>%
        split(.$Expression)
    }
  ) %>%
    set_names(names(l_deg)) %>%
    list_flatten(name_spec = "{outer}_{inner}")

  l_dea <- list.map(
    l_deg_proc,
    f(x) ~ top_genes(
      x,
      fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
      p_threshold = p_threshold,
      return_rank = TRUE,
      n = 300
    )
  )
  
  l_enrich <- list.map(
    l_dea,
    f(x) ~enrichGO(
      gene = pull(x, "gene_name"),
      OrgDb = get(org_lib),
      keyType = "ALIAS",
      ont = "ALL",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      qvalueCutoff = 1,
      universe = Features(seurat)
    )
  )
} else {
  var <- "gene_name"
  
  l_deg_ranked <- list.map(
      l_deg,
      f(x) ~ {
          metric <- "log2FoldChange"
          de_genes_ranked <- top_genes(x, .Machine$double.xmin, 1, n = Inf, expression = TRUE) %>% #, rank = TRUE) %>%
              # mutate(ranked_padj = sign(log2FoldChange) * (log10(padj))) %>%
              pull(metric, name = var) %>%
              sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
              .[!is.na(names(.))] %>%
              .[is.finite(.)] %>%
              .[!duplicated(.)]
      }
  )
  
  l_enrich <- list.map(
      l_deg_ranked,
      f(x) ~ {
          gseGO(
              x,
              ont = "ALL",
              OrgDb = get(org_lib),
              keyType = "ALIAS",
              verbose = FALSE
          ) %>%
              # setReadable(org_lib, 'ENSEMBL') %>%
              suppressWarnings() %>%
              invisible()
      }
  )
}
```

## Plot
```{r}
regex <- pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional

list.map(
    l_enrich ,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      plot_enrich(
        x,
        cex = 0.65,
        label_x = label_x,
        method = method,
        regex = regex,
        n = 15,
        title = z
      )
    }
) %>% 
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

list.map(l_enrich, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = method) %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway GO") %>%
    kable0()

list.map(
  l_enrich,
  f(i, j, k) ~ {
    tmp <- print_enrich(
      i, 
      method = method,
      regex = regex
    )
    if (nrow(tmp) > 1)
  heatmap_enrich_full(
    l_enrich[[j]],
    l_dea[[j]],
    regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
    width_text = 100
  ) + labs( title = paste("Cluster", k), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
     theme_custom()
  }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = NULL, align = "hv")
```

## Save
```{r}
omics2excel(
  l_enrich, 
  file = file.path(path, paste0(method, ".xlsx")), 
  func = function(x) print_enrich(x, method = method)
)
```
